long_biography.plain_text:
Galperti Group grew from a northern Italian metalworking business founded by Roberto Galperti's grandfather. His father, Giovanni Battista, developed its flange operations, and Roberto followed him into the company before becoming managing director. He inherited an interest in the family enterprise and oversaw its next phase of industrial expansion.

Under Galperti's leadership, the group broadened from flanges into valves, large-diameter bearings and specialised forged products. It also established manufacturing operations in the United States, the Middle East, Malaysia and Brazil. His son Andrea now serves as chief executive, while Roberto's career remains defined by turning an inherited regional manufacturer into a broader international industrial group.
